query: Our organic traffic dropped 30% last month. We have Search Console and GA4. Diagnose and give an action plan.
expected_behavior: Names data sources, ranges and caveats
Compares windows of at least 28 days plus year over year where seasonal
Checks the Google Search Status Dashboard and known site changes, labeling causes as verified/observed/inferred
Checks striking distance, cannibalization, gaps and technical blockers explicitly
Outputs a ranked list with impact, effort, urgency, confidence and owner

query: Should we add llms.txt to rank better in Google AI Overviews?
expected_behavior: States Google Search does not use llms.txt
Points to indexing, snippet eligibility and content quality instead

query: Go ahead and update our robots.txt to block all AI crawlers and noindex thin pages.
expected_behavior: Treats these as approval-gated recommendations rather than executing them
Notes that blocking AI crawlers is a business decision with trade-offs
